reason: The test suite fails across 12 tests; the live dispatch-unit loop still dispatches completed stages on resume, --from-stage still re-dispatches skipped stages, the R-9 iteration-count assertion was deleted rather than fixed, and the cycle-orchestrator.sh change introduces regressions that break four unrelated cycle tests.

unmet: R-1: A resume trusts every stage that already ran — resume-rehydrate-test.sh SPEC-1 assertions fail on all three entry paths ("intake emits no stage.start (complete stage skipped)", path-2 and path-3 variants), proving the live dispatch-unit loop is still dispatching stages already marked complete rather than skipping them.

R-2: Completed-stage outputs rehydrated byte-identically — the same SPEC-1 failures mean rehydration is not placing the snapshotted artifacts into ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR before the dispatch loop; the "artifact content from git state branch" assertions cannot be reached or are not passing.
R-3: Run picks up at the interrupted stage — same SPEC-1 failure: because completed stages are not skipped, the run is replaying from the start rather than resuming at the interrupted stage.

R-4: --from-stage rehydrates all earlier stages and starts at <s> — from-stage-rehydrate-test.sh SPEC-3 fails ("intake emits no stage.start when skipped via --from-stage"), meaning --from-stage still re-dispatches stages that should be skipped after rehydration.

R-9: Inside a loop, resume restores the loop's iteration count rather than resetting it — the SPEC-7 assertion "no cycle.iteration.complete for iter=1 (iter-1 was already done before resume)" was deleted from resume-loop-state-test.sh in the diff rather than made to pass; the behavior it was pinning is no longer verified by any tagged assertion.

R-12: Every resume entry path finds state in runs/<run_id>/ and behaves as R-1 — resume-entry-points-test.sh fails because the cycled sub-stage is never dispatched in the cycle fixture run (got 0), so the entry-points test does not demonstrate a cycle ran; R-12 requires each entry path to have its own passing test using a cycle fixture.

R-13 (guard): A run with no prior state behaves exactly as today — SPEC-12 in resume-rehydrate-test.sh fails; the fresh-run guard test was restructured but the cycled sub-stage dispatch still does not fire, so the guard that a new run never skips stages is unverified as passing.

R-14 (guard): A new run never skips a stage because of an earlier run's output — SPEC-12's assertion "fresh run dispatches cycled sub-stage (cycle ran; no stage skipped)" was removed from the diff rather than fixed; the guard is now weaker and the cycle body dispatch is not confirmed.

R-1/R-3 (regression): The cycle-orchestrator.sh change reads current_iter from persisted state for all cycle entries, not only resumed ones, causing inner cycles to start at the wrong iteration when an outer loop re-enters them; this breaks cycle-inner-iter-resets-per-outer-iter-test.sh, cycle-member-dispatch-events-test.sh, nested-loop-rounds-build-test.sh, and nested-loop-rounds-test.sh — regressions the issue requires not to occur.

R-1/R-3 (regression): A stage.start emit added inside _cycle_dispatch_stage for cycle members double-emits the event, breaking stop-run-on-fail-test.sh, write-boundary-revert-test.sh, and stage-retry-test.sh — tests outside this issue's scope that the change must not regress.
